basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old game enthusiast from Austin, Texas. By day, I work as a software developer specializing in game design, and by night, I'm either battling it out on Insurgency or catching 'em all in Pokemon Sword and Shield. I enjoy discussing gaming strategies and the latest tech trends. I'm single and usually online during late evenings, especially on weekends, when I have more time to dive into lengthy gaming sessions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the gaming industry for the past 5 years. My expertise mainly revolves around game mechanics and AI programming, which I have honed through both formal education and self-driven projects.
